label: SIMULATION RESULTS
disclaimer: All results are produced from placeholder-provenance parameters. They exercise the decision problem and the pipeline only and must NOT be presented as real facility performance. No real customer data exists anywhere in this pipeline.
policy_description: Forecast-based autonomous dispatch policy — a rule-based baseline, not a learned or trained model. The nxt_range_ops environment is built to train and evaluate learned policies.

playback.note: 6 ticks/s is the recording-stable rate; higher rates can intermittently blank Plotly frames.

regenerate.3_export_bundle: uv run --no-sync python -m nxt_range_viewer --out reports/demo_bundle --scenario demand_spike --policy demand_forecast_dispatch --seed 101 --benchmark-report reports/range_agent_e1/report.json

determinism_note: The same (scenario, policy, seed) always regenerates identical frames, events, and KPIs; the only environment-dependent field is the meta.git_commit provenance stamp.
counterfactual_note: Same-seed runs of different policies do NOT share an identical exogenous event schedule (demand realization and failure/docking events diverge with policy execution), so no 'avoided X' counterfactual claims are made. Cross-policy statements must cite the paired-seed E1 benchmark statistics instead.

highlights.what_to_say: An unforecast walk-in surge hits at 14:00: demand jumps 2.5x, from ~20 to ~50 balls/min (peak 52.8/min at 15:07). The spike is deliberately absent from the forecast the policy sees - it has to react, not cheat.

The decision panel narrates each autonomous dispatch decision live: the forecast-based policy reads the sensed inventory pipeline against the forecast, detects the shortfall, and staffs collection - assign_collection(R1,Z4) at 14:09, every directive re-validated by the safety shield.
Both robots cycle collect-and-handoff on the map (amber decision lines, trails). A docking failure at 15:26 is retried and absorbed without human help.
Dispenser inventory bottoms out at 1,578 balls at 15:28 - the spike's deepest point.
Inventory recovers to 2,200 by 15:54 and stays positive to close. The washer loop never starves.

Full-day result: maintained zero simulated stockout - 0.0 stockout minutes, 20,751 of 20,751 demanded balls served, 100% service availability, exactly one human assist all day. SIMULATION RESULTS - placeholder parameters, real decision problem.

bonus_beat.what_to_say: Optional: R1 hard-fails in the evening (red ring on the map), the policy requests human assistance, and the robot is recovered in 12 simulated minutes - the episode's single human assist.
